essence: The fear-inducing lamp is to be made using an impossible means.
The prescribed lamp vessel is defined as a two-pala measure.
Ritual action in this context is twofold: auspicious and inauspicious.
The prescribed meditation visualizes Bhairava as white and four-armed.
Bhairava is to be visualized as crown-crested and clad in a white loincloth.
